primary.title: RBI hikes repo rate by 25 bps: How will this hike impact your home loan EMI now?
primary.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) raised the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50% on October 7, 2026, an increase of 25 basis points. For a homebuyer, this 0.25 percentage-point increase immediately impacts your home loan.
